label: Blender
description: Requires Blender 5.1+ (4.x will not connect). Control Blender for 3D modeling and export to UEFN via the official Blender MCP add-on — installed into Blender automatically.

settings.sections.title: Requires Blender 5.1+
settings.sections.description: WARNING: this plugin only works with Blender 5.1 or newer. 4.x cannot run the official MCP add-on and will not connect. Install 5.1 from blender.org, open it once, then restart Blender after this plugin is enabled.

settings.sections.title: Connection
settings.sections.description: On enable, this plugin copies the official Blender MCP add-on into your Blender 5.1+ user extensions and a startup script that enables it. Open (or restart) Blender 5.1+ — the server auto-starts on the port below.

properties.label: Port
properties.description: Blender MCP add-on port (default 9876, matches the add-on preference).

steps.title: Requires Blender 5.1+
steps.body: WARNING: Blender 4.x cannot run this plugin. Install Blender 5.1 or newer from blender.org, open it once, then restart it so the MCP add-on auto-starts on port 9876. No uv / GitHub install.

steps.title: Talk to Blender
steps.body: With Blender 5.1+ open, ask the agent to inspect the scene, find the heaviest mesh, rename datablocks, or model. Tools appear under blender_*. For text/image-to-3D generation, install the meshy or 3D AI Studio Store plugin.
